description: Forget one agent's learned baseline and score and relearn from its next 30 runs over at least 3 days. For intended behavior changes (new model, new task) that left the agent permanently deviating. The reset is permanently visible: records and alarms stay stored, the agent carries rebaselined_at, and the reset itself is recorded as a rebaseline alarm naming the score/band it erased. Record why with kind and reason: both land in that alarm, the timeline and the webhook event. Requires confirm=true and the human's explicit go-ahead.

announcement_id.description: Accept an announced change (see announce_change): closes the announcement and records it as the reason.

key.description: Scoring key; omit when sent as x-kyde-key header.

reason.description: One sentence on why, recorded with the reset.

name: rebaseline
title: Reset agent baseline
